name: Yogurt
description: A scoped appearance and surface for a product.

guidance.useWhen: Scope shared appearance and material to a product surface.
guidance.avoid: Set appearance from the host preference rather than duplicating theme values.

name: Text
description: Body, help and metadata in one typeface.

guidance.useWhen: Display body text or supporting metadata in the shared typography.
guidance.avoid: Use a heading when text names a section.

name: Heading
description: Name a section on its reading edge.

guidance.useWhen: Name a page or section in a meaningful heading hierarchy.
guidance.avoid: Choose heading level by document structure rather than appearance alone.

name: Icon
description: A small glyph with an optional accessible name.

guidance.useWhen: Show a known visual symbol beside a named action or piece of information.
guidance.avoid: Give the action an accessible name independent of its icon.

name: Stack
description: Group content on a vertical rhythm.

guidance.useWhen: Group related content vertically with a shared spacing role.
guidance.avoid: Use content hierarchy rather than a decorative separator for every group.

name: Inline
description: Place related actions on one baseline.

guidance.useWhen: Place related items and actions on one reading line.
guidance.avoid: Allow content to wrap when its available width changes.

name: Grid
description: Let related items wrap as space changes.

guidance.useWhen: Arrange related items in responsive columns.
guidance.avoid: Use a single reading column when comparison is not needed.

name: Surface
description: Keep one task on a quiet plane.

guidance.useWhen: Place a related task on a shared surface.
guidance.avoid: Avoid wrapping every individual element in its own surface.

name: Divider
description: Mark an explicit change of subject.

guidance.useWhen: Indicate an explicit change between related sections.
guidance.avoid: Prefer space and headings when they already distinguish groups.

name: ScrollArea
description: Give an overflowing region its own reading position.

guidance.useWhen: Give a bounded region its own scroll position.
guidance.avoid: Avoid nesting scroll regions without a clear task.

name: Button
description: Commit one named action.

guidance.useWhen: Commit one clearly named action.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a button to navigate to a URL.

name: IconButton
description: Keep a familiar action within reach.

guidance.useWhen: Offer a familiar action when space is constrained.
guidance.avoid: Do not rely on the icon as the only accessible name.

name: ButtonGroup
description: Place actions for one decision together.

guidance.useWhen: Group actions that belong to the same decision.
guidance.avoid: Do not group unrelated actions simply to align them.

name: BottomAction
description: Keep the next step reachable on a small screen.

guidance.useWhen: Keep a task’s next action accessible at the lower edge.
guidance.avoid: Do not cover task content with a fixed action area.

name: Field
description: Connect a label, value and correction.

guidance.useWhen: Associate a control with its label and optional help or error.
guidance.avoid: Do not rely on placeholder text as the only label. The component creates its own label and supporting text.

name: Label
description: Give a control a stable visible name.

guidance.useWhen: Give a form control a persistent visible name.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a placeholder as a replacement for the label.

name: HelpText
description: Explain what the field accepts.

guidance.useWhen: Explain what a field accepts before an error occurs.
guidance.avoid: Do not use help text as the only accessible label.

name: FieldError
description: Keep a correction beside its field.

guidance.useWhen: Describe how to correct an invalid field next to it.
guidance.avoid: Do not identify an error by color alone.

name: TextField
description: Edit one line without losing a draft.

guidance.useWhen: Edit a single line of text with a persistent label.
guidance.avoid: Use a multiline field for longer written input.

name: SearchField
description: Filter records and clear the query in place.

guidance.useWhen: Filter an existing collection by a text query.
guidance.avoid: Do not hide a way to clear the query.

name: Textarea
description: Write a note across several lines.

guidance.useWhen: Edit a note or other multiline text.
guidance.avoid: Use a single-line field for a short value.

name: Select
description: Pick a value from a short list.

guidance.useWhen: Choose from a short stable set of options.
guidance.avoid: Use a searchable choice when the person must find an item in a long set.

name: Combobox
description: Find one stable value in a longer list.

guidance.useWhen: Find and choose one item from a searchable set.
guidance.avoid: Use a simple select when all choices fit comfortably in a short list.

name: Checkbox
description: Choose an independent option.

guidance.useWhen: Select an independent option or membership in a set.
guidance.avoid: Use a radio group when exactly one choice is required. The control does not expose a description association.

name: RadioGroup
description: Choose one of several alternatives.

guidance.useWhen: Choose one option from a small visible set.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a radio group for independent choices. The group does not expose a description association.

name: Switch
description: Apply a setting immediately.

guidance.useWhen: Change a setting that takes effect immediately.
guidance.avoid: Use a checkbox for a choice submitted as part of a form. Use the built-in help property for supporting text.

name: Link
description: Open a named destination.

guidance.useWhen: Navigate to a named destination.
guidance.avoid: Use a button for an action that does not navigate.

name: Breadcrumb
description: Find a parent in the current path.

guidance.useWhen: Show the current location within a hierarchy.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a breadcrumb as the only way to navigate a flat collection.

name: NavigationList
description: Move between product destinations.

guidance.useWhen: Present destinations with one current location.
guidance.avoid: Do not use it for actions or settings that change a value in place.

name: Tabs
description: Switch panels within one context.

guidance.useWhen: Switch among related panels within one context.
guidance.avoid: Use navigation links when choices lead to distinct destinations.

name: SegmentedControl
description: Change the presentation of one value.

guidance.useWhen: Change one view or mode among a few related choices.
guidance.avoid: Use navigation for distinct destinations.

name: Pagination
description: Read one page of a collection.

guidance.useWhen: Move between pages of a collection with known page counts.
guidance.avoid: Do not present page navigation when the total number of pages is unknown.

name: DisclosureRow
description: Reveal related details on demand.

guidance.useWhen: Reveal optional related detail beneath a labeled summary.
guidance.avoid: Do not hide information essential to completing a decision.

name: ActionMenu
description: Choose a secondary command.

guidance.useWhen: Offer secondary commands associated with a specific context.
guidance.avoid: Keep the main task action visible rather than placing it only in the menu.

name: Popover
description: Read a little more without leaving the task.

guidance.useWhen: Show short supporting detail anchored to a control.
guidance.avoid: Use a dialog when the task needs modal focus.

name: Dialog
description: Finish one focused task.

guidance.useWhen: Complete a focused task that needs the current context held in place.
guidance.avoid: Do not open a modal solely to show passive information.

name: Drawer
description: Pull up a task and dismiss it from its lower-edge surface.

guidance.useWhen: Open a temporary task surface from the lower edge.
guidance.avoid: Do not use an overlay for information the reader must compare continuously with the underlying page.

name: Sheet
description: Open more space for a task on a small screen.

guidance.useWhen: Open a temporary task surface with room for additional content.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a sheet to obscure information required throughout the task.

name: Tooltip
description: Explain a compact action on hover or focus.

guidance.useWhen: Explain a compact control on hover or focus.
guidance.avoid: Do not place essential instructions only in a tooltip.

name: FilterBar
description: Narrow a collection in place.

guidance.useWhen: Search a collection and place related filters nearby.
guidance.avoid: Do not treat an empty match as an empty collection.

name: Count
description: Report the size of a named set.

guidance.useWhen: Show the size of a named set alongside the set.
guidance.avoid: Do not present a count without identifying what it counts.

name: List
description: Read related records in order.

guidance.useWhen: Group related records in a labeled semantic list.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a list where aligned columns are essential to compare records.

name: ListRow
description: Give one record an aligned leading and trailing area.

guidance.useWhen: Show one record with optional leading and trailing content.
guidance.avoid: Do not nest independent interactive controls inside a row action.

name: SelectionList
description: Keep a set of choices by their IDs.

guidance.useWhen: Select multiple labeled options by stable ID.
guidance.avoid: Use a single-choice control when exactly one option is allowed.

name: EmptyResult
description: Distinguish an empty collection from no matches.

guidance.useWhen: Explain an empty collection or a search with no matches.
guidance.avoid: Distinguish no matches from an empty collection.

name: Badge
description: Name a category or condition in a few words.

guidance.useWhen: Label a category or compact persistent condition.
guidance.avoid: Use a status announcement when a change needs to be conveyed.

name: Status
description: Announce a meaningful change once.

guidance.useWhen: Announce a meaningful state change near the affected task.
guidance.avoid: Avoid repeating an unchanged announcement.

name: Notice
description: Keep a consequential message beside the task.

guidance.useWhen: Keep a consequential message and optional action beside a task.
guidance.avoid: Reserve urgent alerts for messages that need immediate attention.

name: Skeleton
description: Reserve the shape of incoming content.

guidance.useWhen: Reserve the rough shape of content while it loads.
guidance.avoid: Do not use loading placeholders to imply a successful result.

name: Progress
description: Report actual progress against a maximum.

guidance.useWhen: Show a host-reported amount of work or an indeterminate operation.
guidance.avoid: Do not imply completion before the host reports it.

name: Toast
description: Acknowledge a completed action.

guidance.useWhen: Acknowledge an observed action result without interrupting the task.
guidance.avoid: Keep critical information available beyond a transient message. ToastStack creates its own notices from items.

name: Result
description: Explain what happened and what is available next.

guidance.useWhen: Explain an observed outcome and a next action.
guidance.avoid: Do not present a pending or unknown operation as confirmed.

name: RecordFacts
description: Keep an observed value with its units and source.

guidance.useWhen: Present named observed facts with source and observation time.
guidance.avoid: Do not imply an unknown or stale fact is current.

name: Table
description: Present aligned columns with a caption and semantic row headings.

guidance.useWhen: Display related values in semantic rows and columns with a caption.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a data table solely to arrange page layout. Use semantic table elements for rows; TableRow is a description row.

name: DataTable
description: Compare and sort records by a named column.

guidance.useWhen: Compare records across named columns and optionally sort them.
guidance.avoid: Do not nest this component inside Table; it already renders one. Do not rely on sorting when a column has no sort value.

name: Chart
description: Show change while preserving gaps in the observations.

guidance.useWhen: Show one observed series over an ordered range with source and time.
guidance.avoid: Do not connect gaps or turn missing readings into zero.

name: Legend
description: Name the series and its unit.

guidance.useWhen: Name a chart series and its unit.
guidance.avoid: Do not distinguish data series by color alone.

name: ConfirmDialog
description: Confirm the current revision exactly once.

guidance.useWhen: Confirm a specific available decision and its current revision.
guidance.avoid: Do not send a decision after its revision has changed.

name: Receipt
description: Look up the original request.

guidance.useWhen: Present a request state and optionally check its original ID.
guidance.avoid: The component already renders the request ID, state heading and lookup action when provided.

name: ProjectMark
description: Identify a project with its original artwork.

guidance.useWhen: Identify a project using its supplied original artwork.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a project mark as the company signature.

name: AgentAvatar
description: Show the identity of an agent.

guidance.useWhen: Identify an agent and depict its observed state.
guidance.avoid: Do not rely on animation alone to communicate the state.

name: Gaze
description: Express an observed state with the eyes.

guidance.useWhen: Set the eye expression within an agent illustration.
guidance.avoid: Do not use eyes without the agent silhouette as a standalone status.

name: Message
description: Keep an utterance and its speaker together.

guidance.useWhen: Keep a speaker, their content and optional time together.
guidance.avoid: Do not infer a speaker from color or position alone.

name: Activity
description: Describe the actual state of a reply.

guidance.useWhen: Announce the observed state of an agent reply.
guidance.avoid: Do not mark a reply complete without confirmation.

name: Transcript
description: Read a thread while new replies arrive.

guidance.useWhen: Present a labeled thread that follows new replies until the reader scrolls away.
guidance.avoid: Do not force scrolling to the newest content while the reader is reviewing older messages.

name: ReadingAnchor
description: Return to the newest message when ready.

guidance.useWhen: Return to the newest content when the reader chooses.
guidance.avoid: Do not force the reader away from older content.

name: AspectRatio
description: Reserve the media frame while content loads.

guidance.useWhen: Reserve a predictable media frame while content loads.
guidance.avoid: Use the media native aspect ratio when cropping would conceal necessary content.

name: Direction
description: Set the reading and interaction direction of a region.

guidance.useWhen: Set the reading and interaction direction of a region.
guidance.avoid: Keep the direction consistent with the content and host locale.

name: Card
description: Group related content with a title and optional actions.

guidance.useWhen: Group one related item or task with its title and optional action.
guidance.avoid: Avoid a card around every independent text element.

name: Asset
description: Frame an image, glyph, video or moving asset.

guidance.useWhen: Frame a media asset at the requested size.
guidance.avoid: Preserve the meaning and accessible name of the supplied content.

name: Gradient
description: Blend two palette roles on a decorative surface.

guidance.useWhen: Apply a decorative gradient using a shared tone.
guidance.avoid: Ensure overlaid content remains readable.

name: Elevation
description: Lift a surface above its surroundings.

guidance.useWhen: Express a surface layer with flat, raised or floating elevation.
guidance.avoid: Use elevation only when it clarifies a layering relationship.

name: KeyboardShortcut
description: Show the keys for an available command.

guidance.useWhen: Show the keys for an available command.
guidance.avoid: Provide the named action independently of its shortcut.

name: Post
description: Set the reading width and rhythm of longer copy.

guidance.useWhen: Present longer editorial content with a readable measure.
guidance.avoid: Use ordinary task layout for short interactive controls.

name: GridList
description: Browse a responsive collection of items.

guidance.useWhen: Present a labeled responsive collection of items.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a grid when comparison depends on aligned columns.

name: ListHeader
description: Name a group and supply its optional action.

guidance.useWhen: Introduce a collection with a title, optional detail and action.
guidance.avoid: Do not use an unlabeled icon as the only action.

name: ListFooter
description: Show a collection total or its next action.

guidance.useWhen: Place collection totals or a next action after the items.
guidance.avoid: Do not put critical task context only after a long collection.

name: PageHeader
description: Introduce a page with a title, detail and actions.

guidance.useWhen: Introduce a page with its title, optional context and action.
guidance.avoid: Do not use multiple page-level headings for peer sections.

name: BottomInfo
description: Keep supporting information with the decision it explains.

guidance.useWhen: Keep supporting information near the decision it explains.
guidance.avoid: Do not hide essential consequences behind decorative content.

name: Highlight
description: Draw attention to a word or part of a surface.

guidance.useWhen: Mark a relevant span within content.
guidance.avoid: Do not depend on highlight color alone to convey a warning or error.

name: Spinner
description: Announce an operation of unknown duration.

guidance.useWhen: Indicate an operation whose duration is unknown.
guidance.avoid: Do not use an indefinite spinner as the only explanation for failure.

name: ToastStack
description: Present and dismiss independent notifications.

guidance.useWhen: Present independently dismissible notifications.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a transient notice as the only record of a critical outcome. Pass items instead of nesting Toast children.

name: TableRow
description: Pair a row heading with its value.

guidance.useWhen: Pair one named value with its label.
guidance.avoid: Do not use this description row as a table row element or nest it inside RecordFacts.

name: AmountTop
description: Lead with a quantity and its unit.

guidance.useWhen: Emphasize a named amount with its unit and supporting detail.
guidance.avoid: Do not omit units or imply precision that is not known.

name: BarChart
description: Compare signed or missing readings against a common zero.

guidance.useWhen: Compare named signed readings from a common zero.
guidance.avoid: Do not render a missing reading as a zero value.

name: Avatar
description: Identify a person by portrait or initials.

guidance.useWhen: Identify a person with a portrait or initials fallback.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a person avatar as an agent identity.

name: Bubble
description: Group a speaker’s content by its direction.

guidance.useWhen: Group conversational content by incoming or outgoing direction.
guidance.avoid: Do not rely on alignment alone to identify the speaker.

name: Attachment
description: Show a file, its state and available actions.

guidance.useWhen: Show a named file with optional progress and actions.
guidance.avoid: Do not expose remove or open actions without host support.

name: Marker
description: Place a named event between messages.

guidance.useWhen: Mark a named event in a conversation or sequence.
guidance.avoid: Do not convey the event only through the marker color.

name: CodeBlock
description: Read and copy a labeled code sample.

guidance.useWhen: Present a labeled code sample with a copy action.
guidance.avoid: Do not imply copying succeeded before it is confirmed.

name: Trace
description: Inspect the observed steps in a run.

guidance.useWhen: Inspect named run steps and their observed details.
guidance.avoid: Do not report an unobserved step as complete.

name: InputGroup
description: Keep an input and its prefix or action together.

guidance.useWhen: Edit one value with a directly related prefix, suffix or action.
guidance.avoid: Do not combine unrelated fields in one group.

name: InputOTP
description: Enter or paste a one-time code into a single labeled field.

guidance.useWhen: Enter a short one-time code into a single labeled input.
guidance.avoid: Do not treat a full code as verified without the host result.

name: SplitTextField
description: Edit related segments with individual labels.

guidance.useWhen: Edit related segments with independent accessible labels.
guidance.avoid: Use one field when segments have no separate meaning. Individual parts do not expose a description or error association.

name: Slider
description: Choose a bounded value or interval.

guidance.useWhen: Choose one value or adjust both ends of an interval.
guidance.avoid: Use a numeric stepper when precise discrete steps are more important. The control does not expose a description association.

name: NumericSpinner
description: Change a bounded integer one step at a time.

guidance.useWhen: Adjust a bounded integer one step at a time.
guidance.avoid: Use a slider for a continuous range. Use the built-in help property for supporting text.

name: Rating
description: Read or set a score on a labeled scale.

guidance.useWhen: Read or choose a score from a small labeled ordered scale.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a rating for a non-ordered set of categories.

name: Agreement
description: Review individual terms and change their collective selection.

guidance.useWhen: Review and select individual terms, with a control for selecting all enabled entries.
guidance.avoid: Do not treat selecting terms as proof of submission or acceptance until the host confirms it.

name: Keypad
description: Enter a number or letters with a touch keypad.

guidance.useWhen: Provide on-screen keys for a host-managed input.
guidance.avoid: Do not assume the private layout alone secures sensitive entry.

name: Form
description: Submit and reset a labeled group of native fields.

guidance.useWhen: Group labeled fields for an explicit submit or reset.
guidance.avoid: Do not infer success before the host confirms submission. Set button type explicitly for submit and reset actions.

name: Toggle
description: Turn a persistent action on or off.

guidance.useWhen: Change a persistent on-or-off action.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a toggle for a one-time command.

name: ToggleGroup
description: Select one or more named toolbar options.

guidance.useWhen: Select or deselect named toolbar options as a group.
guidance.avoid: Do not assume the single-selection mode requires a value; it permits deselection. Provide items to the group; do not nest Toggle children.

name: Accordion
description: Open related sections in a single or multiple disclosure group.

guidance.useWhen: Reveal related sections in a labeled disclosure group.
guidance.avoid: Do not hide information essential to completing a decision. Provide items to the group; do not nest DisclosureRow children.

name: ContextMenu
description: Act on a specific item using its contextual commands.

guidance.useWhen: Offer commands scoped to a specific target.
guidance.avoid: Do not make a context menu the only way to access an essential action.

name: HoverCard
description: Inspect related detail on hover, focus or touch.

guidance.useWhen: Show supplementary detail from a labeled trigger.
guidance.avoid: Do not put essential information behind hover alone.

name: Command
description: Find and invoke an enabled command by name.

guidance.useWhen: Find and invoke an available named command.
guidance.avoid: Do not show commands the host cannot execute.

name: Menubar
description: Move between keyboard-accessible command menus.

guidance.useWhen: Group application commands into named menus.
guidance.avoid: Use navigation links for destination changes rather than commands.

name: NavigationMenu
description: Browse groups of related destinations.

guidance.useWhen: Group related destinations under named navigation triggers.
guidance.avoid: Do not mix destination links and state-changing commands without clear distinction.

name: Sidebar
description: Navigate between sections in a persistent or collapsible rail.

guidance.useWhen: Present a persistent or collapsible group of destinations.
guidance.avoid: Do not use the navigation rail to hide the current destination. Sidebar renders its own navigation.

name: Navbar
description: Move back or act from a compact page header.

guidance.useWhen: Introduce a compact page with a back action and optional action.
guidance.avoid: Do not show a back action with no valid host behavior.

name: Carousel
description: Move between ordered items at your own pace.

guidance.useWhen: Let the reader move through ordered items at their own pace.
guidance.avoid: Do not make essential content depend on automatic movement. Its current position cannot be controlled by an external Pagination.

name: Stepper
description: Read the current stage of a multi-step task.

guidance.useWhen: Show the current stage within a known sequence.
guidance.avoid: Do not imply an unconfirmed stage is complete.

name: Resizable
description: Change the relative size of two panes by pointer or keyboard.

guidance.useWhen: Let someone adjust the relative width of two panes.
guidance.avoid: Keep pane content usable at its minimum size.

name: Calendar
description: Choose a civil date in a keyboard-accessible month grid.

guidance.useWhen: Choose a local civil date in a labeled month view.
guidance.avoid: Do not convert a civil date to a time-zone-dependent instant. DatePicker already contains a calendar.

name: DatePicker
description: Open a calendar to change a date.

guidance.useWhen: Choose a local date from a trigger and calendar.
guidance.avoid: Do not use a date picker for a date-and-time value. The control already contains its label and calendar.

name: Questionnaire
description: Answer one or more questions and review the resulting answers.

guidance.useWhen: Collect a sequence of single-choice, multiple-choice or text answers.
guidance.avoid: Do not assume answers are saved before the host confirms completion.

name: AgentRow
description: Recognize a named agent and read its present state, unread activity and recent context.

guidance.useWhen: Show a named agent with its current state and optional unread activity.
guidance.avoid: Do not communicate state or unread activity through animation or color alone. Wrap the button in a list item when placing it in a list.

name: RuntimePanel
description: Check computer availability and open an authorized preview or control action.

guidance.useWhen: Show the observed runtime state and available host-provided actions.
guidance.avoid: Do not imply control or connection was granted before the host confirms it.

name: ResourceRow
description: Open or pin a source while keeping its kind and origin visible.

guidance.useWhen: Show a named resource with its kind and optional open or pin actions.
guidance.avoid: Do not show an action unless the host provides it.

name: ThreadRow
description: Open a conversation within its project.

guidance.useWhen: Show a conversation with optional preview, time and unread state.
guidance.avoid: Do not rely on color alone to identify unread activity.

name: WorkEvent
description: Read a task, handoff, routine or result in the conversation timeline.

guidance.useWhen: Show a named event and its observed state in a timeline.
guidance.avoid: Do not report completion before it is confirmed by the host.

name: RoutineRow
description: Read cadence, the next occurrence and available routine actions.

guidance.useWhen: Show a routine’s cadence, state and available actions.
guidance.avoid: Do not offer execution when the host has not authorized it.

name: Composer
description: Review draft sources and tools, send a message or stop a pending reply.

guidance.useWhen: Prepare a message with optional attachments and tools.
guidance.avoid: Do not enable sending while attachments are still uploading.

name: VoiceControl
description: Present the current voice-note state and the actions the host supports.

guidance.useWhen: Present recording, review and available voice-note actions.
guidance.avoid: Do not show recording controls when the host reports voice unavailable.

name: SidebarLayout
description: Compose a shared navigation shell with an inset, rail or narrow drawer.

guidance.useWhen: Compose persistent navigation that adapts to narrow screens.
guidance.avoid: Keep project-specific destinations in the consuming product. SidebarLayout supplies its own navigation structure.
